title: Quantification of Phosphorus Cycling Functional Genes in Marine Sediments by SYBR Green qPCR
author: DALING WANG
materials: Total genomic DNA was extracted from marine sediments using the PowerSoil®DNA Isolation kit (MoBio, Germany), and quantified prior to qPCR analysis. DNA purity and concentration were measured using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific, USA) to ensure suitability for downstream amplification. The integrity of the DNA was assessed by 1% agarose gel electrophoresis. Notes: ①. A260/A280 ratio: The ideal range is between 1.8 and 2.0. A260/A230 ratio: The ideal value is approximately 2.0. ②. Integrity: When checking DNA integrity through agarose gel electrophoresis, ideally, the DNA should appear as a clear high molecular weight band, indicating that the sample has not degraded.
Construct plamids and extract environmental DNA.

steps.title: Prepare Standard Curves
steps.instruction: Generate standard curves using plasmids containing target genes (phoD, phoX, gcd, and pqqC) to enable absolute quantification.

substeps.instruction: Perform tenfold serial dilutions of plasmids from 10^1 to 10^7 copies µL⁻¹.
Plot Ct values against log10(copy number) using the linear regression equation: Ct = a × log10(copies) + b.
Calculate amplification efficiency using: Efficiency (%) = (10^(-1/slope) − 1) × 100.
Accept only assays with efficiencies between 80% and 110% and R² ≥ 0.95.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR reaction mix on ice and protected from light in a 1.5 or 2.0 mL brown reaction tube.

substeps.instruction: Add components for a 20 µL reaction as specified in Table 2 (including BSA to alleviate inhibitory effects of humic substances).
For multiple samples, multiply reagent volumes by (number of samples + 1) to compensate for pipetting loss.
Mix the solution carefully by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Add DNA Template
steps.instruction: Add the DNA template to the master mix and prepare for amplification.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.0 µL of DNA to the mix and mix carefully by pipetting up and down.
Prepare a no-template control (NTC) using DEPC-treated water (or ddH2O) instead of DNA.
Analyze all samples in triplicate.
Seal tubes with optical tube caps or plates with self-adhesive foil.

steps.title: Run qPCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform real-time PCR using an ABI PRISM 7500 Detection System, detecting fluorescence at approximately 530 nm via the SYBR Green (FAM) channel.

substeps.instruction: For pqqC: 95°C for 10 min; 35 cycles of (95°C for 15 s, 60°C for 30 s, 72°C for 1 min); final extension at 72°C for 5 min.
For phoD: 95°C for 10 min; 35 cycles of (95°C for 15 s, 60°C for 30 s, 72°C for 60 s); final extension at 72°C for 8 min.
For phoX: 95°C for 10 min; 35 cycles of (95°C for 15 s, 63°C for 30 s, 72°C for 1.5 min); final extension at 72°C for 10 min.
For gcd: 95°C for 10 min; 33 cycles of (95°C for 15 s, 60°C for 1 min, 72°C for 45 min); final extension at 72°C for 7 min.
Perform a melting curve analysis at the end of amplification to confirm specificity (single peak indicates specific amplification).

steps.title: Calculate Gene Abundance
steps.instruction: Determine the absolute copy number of target genes in the marine sediment samples.

substeps.instruction: Calculate gene copy numbers using the standard regression curves.
Normalize the copy numbers to the sample dry weight.
Express final results as copies g⁻¹ (dry weight).
